sounds.notes: Earlier death-camera cue, retained for the previous editor build and comparison. Live close sightings use monster_reveal. The death camera uses death_impact.
sounds.prompt: Horror death stinger. A subtle 0.6 s eerie intro of quiet bowed contrabass harmonics and a faint breathy sul ponticello string swell suddenly cuts to a violent orchestral jumpscare hit: dissonant low-brass cluster blast, screeching violin stabs, booming bass drum, deep sub-bass thud. Then a cold dark concert hall reverb tail and an unsettling low cello drone. Real acoustic orchestra, high dynamic range, crisp attack, no vocals, beat or melody.
sounds.name: SFX_DeathJumpscare

sounds.notes: One of three variants on the first sudden close, unobstructed sighting during a live run.
sounds.prompt: Sudden cinematic horror stinger, a single instant shock chord from the first sample. A sharp dissonant screeching violin scrape hits exactly together with a deep metallic sub-bass boom. Brief jagged bow noise, then an eerie dark stone-room reverb tail decaying to silence. No lead-in, no melody, no rhythm, no voice, no second hit.
sounds.name: SFX_MonsterReveal

sounds.notes: Short death-camera impact. Fits before the 2.6-second camera sequence hands off to YOU DIED.
sounds.prompt: A heavy close body impact as the player collapses onto cold stone. A deep muted thud and one abruptly cut breath, with settling cloth and a short low room reverb fading completely. Grim close foley, no orchestra, no violin, no melody, no second sting, no shout.
sounds.name: SFX_DeathImpact

sounds.notes: ALostWithinPlayerController::DeathEndSound default: plays when the YOU DIED screen appears (UI sound, keeps playing while paused).
sounds.prompt: Horror game over sting: one deep ominous sub-bass boom with a reversed metallic swell, then a dark dissonant low drone with faint distant echoes that slowly fades to silence. Final and hopeless, no melody, no voices.
sounds.name: SFX_DeathGameOver

sounds.notes: AToolboxActor::OpenSound default; the lid animation lasts 1 s.
sounds.prompt: Old rusty metal toolbox lid creaking open on stiff hinges, a short metallic squeal and a dull clank as the lid stops. Close-mic, dry, no background.
